name: blueprint/secret-sweep
description: Periodic secret scans as receipts: run the scan pattern over repos, receipt per repo, a hit notifies once and blocks the ship gate
ingredients: rh_run the scan pattern over staged/working trees
recipe: run the scan pattern -> receipt the result (clean or hits) -> a hit: notify once and block the gate -> fix, rescan, receipt
pitfalls: the scan pattern lives in the kit - never commit tokens
a hit is a stop, not a warning
scan staged content, not just the working tree
